data.name: Fire and Brim Co.
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Fire and Brim Co.

Think the 9 to 5 grind is bad on Earth?

Welcome to literal corporate hell, welcome to Fire and Brim Co.

Satan realized he could harvest the souls of humans more efficiently with his demon legion in a WFH (Work From Hell) situation. He tasked his dark employees to use humans' technological advances against them. Today Hell is seeing more soul corruption then ever, but his demons are starting to feel the burnout of corporate existence. The demons longing for a return to the devilish lives they once had. Help our demonic hero, Nedrokanis aka Ned, break free from the mind-numbing chains of Fire and Brim Co.

Is This Game For You?

Fire & Brim Co. is for anyone who loves the classic top-down shooter experiences but also enjoys a rich story filled with bizarre and lovable characters. Unlock powerful demonic magics and modifiers to create unique attacks. 

Game Features

  • Unlockable attacks and modifiers to customize your play style

  • Bizarre and lovable characters

  • A wild and wacky story 

  • Ongoing Development

data.short_description: Embark on a wild and wacky adventure in this top-down action RPG! Take on the role of Ned, a disgruntled demon employee seeking to restore Hell's former glory. Fight your way through the corporate ladder of Fire and Brim Co., to confront its leaders and its evil CEO Satan!

  • VR Support: No
